items.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995
items.q: I never met him. His son became an actor. Roger Pryor. I played his act.

ctx.x: Well when I was a young boy, maybe twelve or thirteen, I was starting to play trombone, I don’t think anyone else ever got this but there was a trombone player by the name of Arthur Pryor.
Oh my goodness. I never met him. His son became an actor. Roger Pryor. I played his act.

Anyway, isn’t that funny that I would listen to these records you know and no jazz, you know, but he had a beautiful tone. And isn’t that funny that I have to say that Arthur Pryor impressed me. And of course well then, let’s see the trombone player with Isham Jones, I liked him too.
